title: Endpoint Short Cycles
abstract: For uniformly endpoint-regularly varying Luce arrays, this paper identifies the logarithmically diverging mean of every fixed cycle length and proves joint fixed-order factorial-moment asymptotics. The coefficients are diagonal convolution traces of the multiplicative endpoint kernel. The proof combines source-to-target endpoint saddle estimates, a global scheduled-deletion cycle envelope, continuum and discrete logarithmic trace limits, and factorial-moment summation.
